description: Search and compare AI companion / AI girlfriend apps (18+). Use this when an adult user asks which AI companion apps exist, wants Candy.ai, OurDream, Lovescape, GirlfriendGPT, Nomi or Kupid compared, or asks for an app that fits what they want. Returns structured, sourced records: name, category, the provider's own description and a link. Only call for users who are 18+ and asked for this; empty query lists all.
